0022600088.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Raptors host the Bulls, and Toronto will be without Brandon Ingram (out, Achilles surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot). Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins (both out, illness) and Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Isaac Okoro, Leonard Miller, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Toronto won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 139-109 win in the last meeting on March 18, 2026, in Chicago.
